meta.name: add-ollama-tool
meta.description: Add Ollama MCP server so the container agent can call local models and optionally manage the Ollama model library.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加本地 Ollama 服务，容器代理可直接调用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你的容器代理需要调用本地 Ollama 模型，又不想手动折腾配置
copy.tagline_en: Connect your container agent to local Ollama models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your container agent needs to call local Ollama models and you'd prefer a straightforward setup

howto.what: Claude 仍是统筹者,但可以把任务交给本机 Ollama 守护进程提供的模型。它能列出已安装的模型,并把提示词发给指定模型取回回答;若开启管理开关,还能拉取、删除、查看模型信息。
howto.when: 当你在对话里要求用 Ollama 本地模型生成回答,或让 Claude 列出、管理已安装模型时,它会调用 ollama 相关工具接管。

say.text: 用 ollama 告诉我法国的首都是哪里
say.note: 它会先列出模型,再让其中一个模型作答

say.text: 列出当前装好的 ollama 模型
say.note: 返回模型名称、大小和家族
需先开启 OLLAMA_ADMIN_TOOLS 才会执行

howto.what_en: Claude stays the orchestrator but can offload work to local Ollama models. It can list installed models and send a prompt to a chosen model for a response; with the admin flag, it can also pull, delete, or show models.
howto.when_en: Fires when you ask Claude to generate an answer with a local Ollama model, or to list or manage installed models.

say_en.text: Use ollama to tell me the capital of France
say_en.note: It lists models, then generates with one

say_en.text: List the ollama models installed right now

say_en.note: Only runs if OLLAMA_ADMIN_TOOLS is set
